**q25:**
- Engine: CEL (Common Expression Language) via `google/cel-go` — `internal/filter/engine.go`
- Mechanism: Each dialect driver calls `filter.AppendConditions()` (`internal/filter/helpers.go`) which compiles the CEL expression to an AST, lowers it to an IR condition tree via `buildCondition`, then renders dialect-specific SQL (sqlite/mysql/postgres) via `renderer.Render()` (`internal/filter/render.go`) using the target `DialectName`.

**q26:** `memo_relation`, `attachment`, `memo`
(The handler also recursively deletes comment memos via `MemoRelationComment`, so the same three tables are hit for each comment; `store/memo.go:140-158`, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:567-577`)

**q27:**
- Mechanism: `//go:embed dist/*` directive with Echo's `StaticWithConfig` middleware
- Path: `server/router/frontend/frontend.go` (embed at line 20-21, serve at lines 54-59)

**q28:**
- `s3presign runner` — 12-hour `time.Ticker` (`server/server.go:162-171`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`)
- Unused infra: `internal/scheduler` package (full cron scheduler, never imported by the server); `server/runner/memopayload` Runner (its `RunOnce` is never started as a background task — only the `RebuildMemoPayload` function is called inline during memo create/update)

**q29:**
- Interceptor: `web/src/connect.ts` (lines 156-178, `authInterceptor`)
- Token kinds: access token (short-lived JWT), refresh token (JWT in HTTP cookie), personal access token (PAT)
- Backend validation package: `server/auth/` (`authenticator.go` dispatches to access-token/refresh-token/PAT validation; backend Connect interceptor at `server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go:205-239`)

**q30:**
- `memos.memo.created`: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`
- `memos.memo.updated`: `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook`
- `memos.memo.deleted`: `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook`
- `memos.memo.comment.created`: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook`
- All defined in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`
- Delivery convergence: `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` (lines 184, 120)
